Create a basemap view

Source: R/basemap.R
basemap.Rd

A map view to render headlessly: one style, or several stacked. The view is a centre and MapLibre zoom (512 px tiles; fractional zooms are rendered natively, not resampled), or bounds to fit. width and height are CSS pixels; images are pixel_ratio times larger with the same view and label layout (MapLibre's devicePixelRatio): pixel_ratio = 2 gives a sharp 2x image, pixel_ratio = dpi / 96 matches a print resolution.

Usage

basemap(
  style,
  width = 800L,
  height = 600L,
  center = NULL,
  zoom = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  crs = NULL,
  pixel_ratio = 1,
  layers = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  features = NULL,
  auth_token = NULL,
  tile_timeout_ms = 10000L,
  max_tiles = 256L,
  tile_concurrency = 16L,
  fail_on_tile_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

style

A MapLibre GL style URL or JSON string (e.g. from basemap_provider()), or a character vector / list of those stacked bottom to top (e.g. a basemap published as separate hillshade, base and label services).

width, height

View size in CSS pixels.

center

c(longitude, latitude) of the view centre.

zoom

MapLibre zoom (0–22, fractional allowed).

bounds

Bounds to fit instead of center/zoom: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in crs (default EPSG:4326), an sf::st_bbox() result, or an sf / sfc object.

crs

CRS of bounds (anything sf::st_crs() accepts).

pixel_ratio

Device pixels per CSS pixel.

layers

Optional layer filter applied to every style: plain IDs keep only those layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop them; * and ? are wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names that match no layer of any style warn.

labels

TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops the labels (text and icons), "only" keeps only the labels on a transparent background, to stack over another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch to their label-free or label-only tiles.

features

Optional feature filter applied to every style: plain names keep those features, minus-prefixed names drop them, e.g. c("water", "roads") or "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, other (the feature column of list_layers()). Features no layer of any style belongs to warn.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service.

tile_timeout_ms

Per-tile HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

max_tiles

Maximum tiles fetched per style.

tile_concurrency

Parallel tile downloads.

fail_on_tile_error

Abort on a failed tile instead of leaving it empty.

Value

A basemap object.

Details

Render it with render_png(), render_svg(), render_raster() or render_array(). The same function exists in Python (basemapper.basemap()) and Rust (Basemap::new()), with the same arguments.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ugrc <- "https://tiles.arcgis.com/tiles/99lidPhWCzftIe9K/arcgis/rest/services"
styles <- sprintf("%s/%s/VectorTileServer/resources/styles/root.json", ugrc,
                  c("VectorHillshade", "LiteBase", "LiteLabels"))
m <- basemap(styles, 800, 600, center = c(-111.8887, 40.7556), zoom = 12.4,
             pixel_ratio = 2)
render_png(m, "slc.png")   # 1600 x 1200
render_svg(m, "slc.svg")   # vector
r <- render_raster(m)      # terra SpatRaster in EPSG:3857

# Fit a layer's extent
nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
m <- basemap("OpenFreeMap.Positron", bounds = nc)
} # }
